description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of training examples and the overall ROUGE-G score for different models. The x-axis is labeled “# Training Examples” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64, with tick marks at intervals of 16. The y-axis is labeled “Overall ROUGE-G Score” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 19.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.0. A green solid line, labeled “PELMS”, begins at approximately 16.0 when the number of training examples is 0, rises steadily to approximately 18.5 when the number of training examples is 64. A green dashed line, labeled “PELMS (5%)”, begins at approximately 15.0 when the number of training examples is 0, and rises steadily to approximately 17.5 when the number of training examples is 64. A red solid line, labeled “Primera”, begins at approximately 15.5 when the number of training examples is 0, and rises to approximately 17.0 when the number of training examples is 64. A red dashed line, labeled “Primera (5%)”, begins at approximately 14.5 when the number of training examples is 0, and rises to approximately 16.0 when the number of training examples is 64. An orange solid line, labeled “Centrum”, begins at approximately 14.0 when the number of training examples is 0, and rises to approximately 15.5 when the number of training examples is 64. An orange dashed line, labeled “Centrum (5%)”, begins at approximately 13.0 when the number of training examples is 0 and rises to approximately 15.0 when the number of training examples is 64. A blue solid line, labeled “Pegasus-X”, begins at approximately 16.0 when the number of training examples is 0 and remains mostly at the same level until approximately 16.5 when the number of training examples is 64. A blue dashed line, labeled “Pegasus-X (5%)”, begins at approximately 12.5 when the number of training examples is 0 and declines to approximately 11.5 when the number of training examples is 64.
